# E047 -- Widelab Brand Guidelines

## Metadata
- **Company:** Widelab
- **Industry:** Agency / Design
- **Year:** 2023
- **Source file:** widelab-2023-pdf.pdf
- **Pages:** 101
- **Language:** EN
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 3-13, 20-40

## Brand Strategy
- Titled "Brand Guidelines" (referred to as "brandbook")
- Founded 2017, described as "Design-Driven" company
- Services: UI/UX, Branding, Marketing
- Philosophy: "Be brave and go wide everyday"
- TOC: Logo Construction, Brand Signet, Materials, Color Variants, Animation, Typography, Photography, Illustrations, Headline Construction, Social Media
- Design agency creating its own brand system -- self-referential credibility

## Logo
- **Logotype** -- primary mark (visual, text extraction minimal)
- **Brand Signet** -- secondary icon/mark
- Protective field: "A" unit measurement; no other elements within protective field
- Signet has tighter protective field variant: 3.5A height context
- Minimum size specifications with 0.25A and 1.5A measurement grid
- Construction grid provided with precise proportional system

## Typography
- **Sequel Sans** -- primary font family
- Headline properties: Roman Display weight, 100% line height, 160 font size, -1% letter spacing
- Type scale:
  - Big-Headline: 100% line height
  - Big-Sentence: 105% line height, -1% letter spacing
  - Small-Headline: 100% line height, -1% letter spacing
  - Small-Sentence: 100% line height, -1% letter spacing
- Body text: 2% letter spacing, auto line height
- Rule: "In sentences we can bold maximum 2 words or groups of words"
- Grid and composition system with A/X proportional units for text layout

- **Black:** #151515 / RGB 21, 21, 21

- **Icons:** 240x240 grid, simple style

- **Illustrations:** abstract style + data charts
- **Social media** section included (details in later pages)

## Photography
- **Team photography:** emphasis on "good fun and emotions and team relationships"; avoid posed photos
- **Portraits:** positive vibe with business character
- Portfolio presentation breakdown: 35% project presentation, 35% full view, 15% UI details, 15% mockups

## Applications
- Merch: "good quality material and a minimal level of branding"
- Social media (dedicated section)
- Portfolio/case study presentations (Behance referenced)
- Client testimonial layouts with attributed quotes

## Tone of Voice
- Casual, design-community vernacular: "grab what u want", "Be brave and go wide everyday"
- Confident self-promotion: "Designing great products is hard. We've done over 300 of them."
- Client testimonials integrated as brand voice proof points

## Outliers
- **101-page document** for a design agency's own brand -- unusually thorough self-application
- Animation easing curves specified with cubic-bezier values -- rare in brand guidelines, shows digital-first thinking
- Explicit portfolio composition ratios (35/35/15/15) -- unique guideline for how to present work
- Bolding rule ("maximum 2 words or groups of words") is an unusually specific typographic constraint
- Yellow hex value appears identical to Purple in text extraction (#4734F7) -- likely a PDF rendering/extraction issue; actual yellow value shown as RGB 230, 235, 39
- Design token naming convention (Gray 50-1000, Purple 100-500) mirrors developer-friendly systems like Tailwind

## Quality Score
- **4/5** -- Comprehensive, modern, digital-first brand system with excellent typography specs, animation guidelines, and photography direction; the design token approach to color is forward-thinking; loses a point due to heavy reliance on visuals that don't extract well as text, and some inconsistencies in color values
